تقتلعي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَلِعِي (taqtaliʕī) /taq.ta.li.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# تُقْتَلَعِي (tuqtalaʕī) /tuq.ta.la.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
